about: Lethbridge County is a municipal district in southern Alberta surrounding the separate City of Lethbridge—not the city itself. Irrigated hamlets such as Diamond City, Iron Springs, Monarch, and Shaughnessy sit among sugar-beet and grain country. Towns such as Coaldale, Picture Butte, Coalhurst, and Nobleford remain separate. About 10,000 people live in Lethbridge County.
